commands.spec.zh-CN: 规格驱动开发工作流；不带参数会列出当前状态可用的动作
commands.spec.en-US: Spec-driven development workflow; no arguments lists the actions available now

actions.new.description.zh-CN: 创建并激活一个新规格，会依次询问名称和标题
actions.new.description.en-US: Create and activate a spec; asks for a name and title

actions.use.description.zh-CN: 从项目 .pi/specs/ 中选择一个规格
actions.use.description.en-US: Choose one of the specs in this project's .pi/specs/

actions.status.description.zh-CN: 显示阶段、状态和剩余任务
actions.status.description.en-US: Show the stage, status and remaining tasks

actions.approve.description.zh-CN: 文档已提交，等待你确认当前版本
actions.approve.description.en-US: The document is submitted and waiting for your confirmation

actions.revise.description.zh-CN: 重新打开某个已开始阶段的文档，并清除下游批准
actions.revise.description.en-US: Reopen a started stage's document and clear downstream approvals

actions.continue.description.zh-CN: 把控制权交回模型，按依赖继续实现
actions.continue.description.en-US: Hand control back to the model to keep implementing

actions.stop.description.zh-CN: 恢复原工具集，磁盘产物保留
actions.stop.description.en-US: Restore the previous tool set; disk artifacts are kept

menu.titleInactive.zh-CN: 当前没有激活的规格，现在做什么？

menu.titleBlocked.zh-CN: 规格恢复失败，已阻止工具执行。先选择处理方式：
menu.titleBlocked.en-US: Spec recovery failed and tools are blocked. Choose how to proceed:

menu.pickStage.zh-CN: 选择要回退重开的阶段

menu.usageHeader.zh-CN: 当前可用动作（非交互模式不提供菜单）：
menu.usageHeader.en-US: Available actions (no menu in non-interactive mode):

new.slugPrompt.zh-CN: 新规格名称（小写字母、数字、连字符）
new.slugPrompt.en-US: New spec name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens)

errors.noSpecsFound.zh-CN: 项目里还没有任何规格，先用 /spec new 创建一个。
errors.noSpecsFound.en-US: This project has no specs yet; create one with /spec new first.

errors.approvalNotPending.zh-CN: 当前没有待批文档（状态：{status}），不需要请求批准。
errors.approvalNotPending.en-US: Nothing is awaiting approval (status: {status}); no approval request is needed.

approve.cancelled.zh-CN: 已取消批准，文档仍处于待批状态
approve.cancelled.en-US: Approval cancelled; the document is still awaiting approval

approvalRequest.description.zh-CN: 请你确认提交的规格文档。会弹出确认对话框；用户未按键就不会产生批准，也不会自动推进阶段。
approvalRequest.description.en-US: Ask you to confirm the submitted spec document. Opens a confirmation dialog; without a keypress there is no approval and no automatic stage advance.

approvalRequest.snippet.zh-CN: 请用户确认当前待批文档
approvalRequest.snippet.en-US: Ask the user to confirm the pending document

approvalRequest.guidelines.zh-CN: spec_submit 返回待批后调用 spec_request_approval 请用户确认；不要假装用户已批准，也不要改用其他方式推进阶段。
approvalRequest.guidelines.en-US: After spec_submit reports a pending document, call spec_request_approval to ask the user; never claim approval the user did not give.

approvalRequest.approved.zh-CN: {detail} 请按当前阶段方法继续。
approvalRequest.approved.en-US: {detail} Continue with the current stage procedure.

submit.description.zh-CN: 提交当前阶段的规格文档供用户审阅。写完当前阶段文档后必须调用；不会自动批准。
submit.description.en-US: Submit the current stage document for user review. Must be called after writing it; never auto-approves.

submit.snippet.zh-CN: 提交当前阶段文档，等待用户批准
submit.snippet.en-US: Submit current stage document for user approval

submit.guidelines.zh-CN: 使用 spec_submit 提交当前阶段的规格文档，等待用户明确批准，不得自动进入下一阶段。
submit.guidelines.en-US: Use spec_submit to hand in the current stage document and wait for explicit user approval.

errors.noSlug.zh-CN: 没有提供规格名称。直接运行 /spec new 会提示你输入。
errors.noSlug.en-US: No spec name was provided. Run /spec new on its own to be prompted.

errors.useNeedsSlug.zh-CN: 非交互模式需要显式指定规格名：/spec use <slug>。
errors.useNeedsSlug.en-US: Non-interactive mode needs an explicit spec name: /spec use <slug>.

errors.reviseNeedsStage.zh-CN: 非交互模式需要显式指定阶段：/spec revise <requirements|design|tasks|verification>。
errors.reviseNeedsStage.en-US: Non-interactive mode needs an explicit stage: /spec revise <requirements|design|tasks|verification>.

errors.unknownSubcommand.zh-CN: 未知子命令 {sub}，下面列出当前可用的动作。
errors.unknownSubcommand.en-US: Unknown subcommand {sub}; current actions are listed below.

errors.slugInvalid.zh-CN: slug 只能包含小写字母、数字、连字符（不得以连字符开头或结尾）：{slug}
errors.slugInvalid.en-US: slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (no leading/trailing hyphen): {slug}

errors.specExists.zh-CN: 规格已存在：{slug}，未修改任何文件
errors.specExists.en-US: Spec already exists: {slug}, no files were modified

errors.stateCorrupt.zh-CN: 状态文件损坏（{path}）：{reason}；请人工检查，插件不会覆盖它
errors.stateCorrupt.en-US: State file corrupted ({path}): {reason}; manual inspection required, plugin will not overwrite

errors.noActiveSpec.zh-CN: 当前没有激活的规格，先执行 /spec new 或 /spec use
errors.noActiveSpec.en-US: No active spec; run /spec new or /spec use first

errors.nothingToApprove.zh-CN: 当前阶段没有待批文档（状态：{status}）
errors.nothingToApprove.en-US: Nothing to approve in the current stage (status: {status})

errors.reviseInvalidArtifact.en-US: Only requirements/design/tasks/verification can be reopened, not: {artifact}

errors.notApprovedForExecute.zh-CN: tasks 尚未获得执行授权（当前：{status}），请先 /spec approve
errors.notApprovedForExecute.en-US: Tasks are not authorized for execution (current: {status}); run /spec approve first

errors.hashMismatch.zh-CN: 检测到 {artifact} 在批准后被修改，批准已失效，阶段已回退到草稿
errors.hashMismatch.en-US: {artifact} was modified after approval; approval invalidated and stage reopened

guards.bashBlocked.zh-CN: spec 模式计划阶段禁止 bash 命令（阶段：{stage}）；完成当前文档后调用 spec_submit。
guards.bashBlocked.en-US: bash is blocked in spec planning stages (stage: {stage}); call spec_submit after finishing the document.

guards.writeDenied.zh-CN: spec 模式当前阶段只允许写入 {allowed}；尝试写入：{path}
guards.writeDenied.en-US: This spec stage only allows writing {allowed}; attempted: {path}

guards.specDirProtected.zh-CN: 禁止通过普通写入工具修改规格目录：{path}（如需变更请使用 /spec revise）
guards.specDirProtected.en-US: Spec directory is protected from raw writes: {path} (use /spec revise for changes)

guards.stateProtected.zh-CN: state.json 由插件管理，禁止直接写入
guards.stateProtected.en-US: state.json is managed by the plugin and cannot be written directly

approve.confirmBody.zh-CN: 批准将绑定当前文档版本的哈希，并进入下一阶段。文件：{path}
approve.confirmBody.en-US: Approval binds to the current document hash and advances to the next stage. File: {path}

approve.revised.zh-CN: {artifact} 已回退到起草状态，下游批准已清除

approve.headlessHint.zh-CN: 文档已登记待批。请切换到交互模式执行 /spec approve 完成批准。
approve.headlessHint.en-US: Document registered for review. Switch to interactive mode and run /spec approve to confirm.

ui.allTasksDone.zh-CN: 全部任务完成（{total}），进入验证阶段

ui.stopped.zh-CN: 已退出 spec 模式并恢复原工具集
ui.stopped.en-US: Exited spec mode and restored the previous tool set

ui.profileStrict.zh-CN: strict：每阶段审批（需求/设计/任务逐阶段人工批准）
ui.profileStrict.en-US: strict: approve requirements, design, and tasks separately

ui.profileQuick.zh-CN: quick：自动接受需求和设计，任务与验证仍需人工审批
ui.profileQuick.en-US: quick: accept requirements/design automatically; tasks and verification need human approval

ui.diskRevisionChanged.zh-CN: 磁盘状态已变化（revision {from} → {to}），以磁盘为准
ui.diskRevisionChanged.en-US: Disk state changed (revision {from} → {to}); using disk state

ui.continueExecution.zh-CN: 继续执行已批准的规格任务。
ui.continueExecution.en-US: Continue executing the approved spec tasks.

ui.frontmatterRepaired.zh-CN: 已按 state.json 校准派生 frontmatter：{files}
ui.frontmatterRepaired.en-US: Derived frontmatter brought back in line with state.json: {files}

frontmatter.notice.zh-CN: 本区块由 pi-spec 自动生成，仅供阅读；状态与批准以 state.json 为准
frontmatter.notice.en-US: Generated by pi-spec for readability; state.json is authoritative for state and approval

errors.frontmatterSyncFailed.zh-CN: 派生 frontmatter 写入失败（state.json 不受影响）：{files}
errors.frontmatterSyncFailed.en-US: Failed to write derived frontmatter (state.json is unaffected): {files}

errors.transitionRejected.zh-CN: 状态机拒绝了操作 {action}（当前：{status}）

errors.submitNoActive.zh-CN: 当前没有激活的规格。请让用户执行 /spec new 或 /spec use。
errors.submitNoActive.en-US: No active spec. Ask the user to run /spec new or /spec use.

errors.submitNotDrafting.zh-CN: 当前状态 {status} 不能提交；只有 drafting 状态可提交。
errors.submitNotDrafting.en-US: State {status} cannot be submitted; only drafting may submit.

errors.artifactMissing.zh-CN: 文档不存在：{path}，请先创建该文档。
errors.artifactMissing.en-US: Artifact not found: {path}; create it first.

submit.awaiting.zh-CN: 文档已登记待批。调用 spec_request_approval 请用户确认，或等待用户执行 /spec approve。
submit.awaiting.en-US: Artifact is awaiting approval. Call spec_request_approval to ask the user, or wait for the user to run /spec approve.

submit.advanced.zh-CN: 已按 quick 模式推进到 {stage}，请继续起草该阶段文档。
submit.advanced.en-US: Quick mode advanced to {stage}; continue drafting that artifact.

errors.stateSchema.zh-CN: 规格状态格式、标识或审批链无效。
errors.stateSchema.en-US: Invalid spec state format, identity, or approval chain.

errors.stateMissing.zh-CN: 规格状态文件已丢失，拒绝覆盖
errors.stateMissing.en-US: Spec state file is missing; refusing to overwrite

errors.revisionConflict.zh-CN: 状态版本冲突：磁盘 {disk}，预期 {expected}

errors.confirmationChanged.zh-CN: 规格或文档版本已变化，本次操作已停止。请检查当前状态后重试。
errors.confirmationChanged.en-US: The spec or document version changed. This operation was stopped; review the current state and retry.

errors.operationFailed.en-US: Spec operation failed and did not complete: {reason}

errors.restoreBlocked.zh-CN: 规格恢复失败，已阻止工具执行：{reason}。请用 /spec use <slug> 重新选择或 /spec stop 退出。
errors.restoreBlocked.en-US: Spec recovery failed; tool execution is blocked: {reason}. Recover with /spec use <slug> or exit with /spec stop.

errors.unknownTask.zh-CN: 忽略未知任务完成标记：{task}，它不在当前已批准的任务定义中。
errors.unknownTask.en-US: Ignoring completion marker for unknown task {task}; it is not in the current approved task definitions.

context.current.zh-CN: 当前规格：{slug}；阶段：{phase}；状态：{status}；模式：{profile}；revision：{revision}。仅以此当前状态和当前阶段方法为准，历史阶段说明不再适用。规格目录：{directory}。
context.current.en-US: Current spec: {slug}; phase: {phase}; status: {status}; profile: {profile}; revision: {revision}. Follow this current state and procedure; historical stage instructions no longer apply. Spec directory: {directory}.

context.remaining.zh-CN: 当前未完成任务：{remaining}。完成标记不是验证证据。
context.remaining.en-US: Currently incomplete tasks: {remaining}. Completion markers are not verification evidence.

context.draft.zh-CN: 当前可编辑产物：{path}。完成文档后调用 spec_submit，按返回状态继续或等待。
context.draft.en-US: Current editable artifact: {path}. Call spec_submit after writing it, then continue or wait according to the returned state.

context.waiting.zh-CN: 已提交，等待用户批准（spec_request_approval 或 /spec approve）。不要编辑文档、继续实现或重复提交；需修改时请用户 /spec revise {phase}。
context.waiting.en-US: Submitted; wait for user approval (spec_request_approval or /spec approve). Do not edit documents, continue implementation or resubmit; ask the user for /spec revise {phase} if changes are needed.

context.complete.zh-CN: 验证文档已获批准，规格工作流完成。汇报实际证据与残留项，不创建新阶段文档、不继续执行。新工作请用户 revise 或 /spec stop。
context.complete.en-US: The verification artifact is approved and this spec workflow is complete. Report actual evidence and residuals; do not create another stage artifact or continue execution. Ask the user to revise or /spec stop for new work.

errors.procedure.zh-CN: 当前阶段方法加载失败：{reason}
errors.procedure.en-US: Failed to load the current stage procedure: {reason}
